properties.Notes: Apo Prohibits Certain Non-Residential Uses Which May Contaminate Groundwater (E.g. Fueling Station, Carwash, Landfill, Dry Cleaning Facility). Apo Also Prohibits Any Development Which Makes Over 50% Of The Lot Area Impervious And Requires Additional Drainage Calculations For Developments Which Make Over 20% Of The Lot Area Impervious.
